name: Discer.io
tagline: An educational sandbox game where players build agent workflows from blocks and watch them compete.

awards: YC x HackPrinceton Challenge by Y Combinator
Best Use of Dedalus by Dedalus Labs

problem: Few people understand how AI agents work, and resources are text- or code-heavy.
solution: A drag-and-drop block editor for agent workflows in a multiplayer sandbox where workflows compete side by side.
demo_moment: Team-described: build two agent workflows and watch them battle.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “YC x HackPrinceton Challenge by Y Combinator” and “Best Use of Dedalus by Dedalus Labs” among 195 submissions.
Positioned as Scratch for agentic AI.

lessons: "Scratch for X" is a quick way to explain an educational tool.
